questions.stem: What is the sum of all solutions to \(|2x - 3| = 7\)?
questions.explanation:
An absolute value equation has two cases.
$$\begin{aligned}2x - 3 &= 7 & 2x - 3 &= -7 \\ 2x &= 10 & 2x &= -4 \\ x &= 5 & x &= -2\end{aligned}$$
The sum of all solutions is \(5 + (-2) = 3\).

questions.stem: The function \(g\) is defined by \(g(x) = 2x^3 - 5\). What is the value of \(g(-2)\)?
questions.explanation:
Substitute \(x = -2\) into the function.
$$g(-2) = 2(-2)^3 - 5 = 2(-8) - 5 = -16 - 5 = -21$$

questions.stem: A researcher surveys 150 randomly selected customers at a grocery store chain and finds that 60% of them prefer paper bags over plastic bags. Which of the following conclusions is best supported by this data?
choices: All customers at the chain prefer paper bags over plastic bags.
Approximately 60% of all customers at the chain likely prefer paper bags.
The researcher should have surveyed more stores before drawing any conclusion.
Exactly 60% of all customers at the chain prefer paper bags.
questions.explanation:
A random sample can be used to make an inference about the population from which it was drawn. The word approximately correctly reflects that a sample estimate may differ slightly from the true population value.
A) Too strong — a sample cannot establish a universal claim. C) Random selection is already sufficient. D) “Exactly” is never supported by a sample estimate.

questions.stem: The function \(f\) is defined by \(f(x) = -3x + 120\), where \(f(x)\) represents the number of items remaining in a warehouse after \(x\) days. For what value of \(x\) does \(f(x) = 48\)?
questions.explanation:
Set \(f(x) = 48\) and solve for \(x\).
$$\begin{aligned}-3x + 120 &= 48 \\ -3x &= -72 \\ x &= 24\end{aligned}$$

questions.stem: A store reduced the price of a jacket from \$240 to \$180. What was the percent decrease in the price of the jacket?
questions.explanation:
Percent decrease \(= \dfrac{\text{original} - \text{new}}{\text{original}} \times 100\).
$$\frac{240 - 180}{240} \times 100 = \frac{60}{240} \times 100 = 25\%$$

questions.stem: For what value of \(k\) does the equation \(3x + 6 = 3(x + k)\) have infinitely many solutions?
questions.explanation:
Expand the right side: \(3x + 6 = 3x + 3k\). Subtract \(3x\) from both sides: \(6 = 3k\). For infinitely many solutions, this must be true for all values of \(x\) — which means the equation must be an identity.
$$6 = 3k \implies k = 2$$
When \(k = 2\), both sides are identical, giving infinitely many solutions. When \(k \neq 2\), the equation has no solution.

questions.stem: $$y > 2x - 1$$$$y \leq -x + 8$$Which of the following points \((x, y)\) is a solution to the given system of inequalities?
questions.explanation:
Test each point in both inequalities.
B) (2, 4): \(4 > 2(2)-1 = 3\) ✓ and \(4 \leq -(2)+8 = 6\) ✓. Keep B.
A) (3, 5): \(5 > 2(3)-1 = 5\) — not strictly greater. Eliminate A.
C) (4, 3): \(3 > 2(4)-1 = 7\) — false. Eliminate C.
D) (5, 2): \(2 > 2(5)-1 = 9\) — false. Eliminate D.

questions.explanation:

questions.stem:
$$2x + 4y = 8$$
$$kx + 2y = 3$$
For what value of \(k\) does the system of equations above have no solution?
questions.explanation:
A system has no solution when the lines are parallel — same slope but different \(y\)-intercepts. Write each equation in slope-intercept form.
$$\begin{aligned}2x + 4y &= 8 \implies y = -\tfrac{1}{2}x + 2 \\ kx + 2y &= 3 \implies y = -\tfrac{k}{2}x + \tfrac{3}{2}\end{aligned}$$
Set slopes equal: \(-\frac{1}{2} = -\frac{k}{2} \implies k = 1\). Check: the \(y\)-intercepts are 2 and \(\frac{3}{2}\), which are different, confirming no solution.

questions.stem: A line of best fit for data comparing years of work experience \((x)\) and annual salary in thousands of dollars \((y)\) has the equation \(y = 3.2x + 42\). What does \(3.2\) represent in this context?
choices: The predicted starting salary in thousands of dollars with no experience
The number of years needed to reach a salary of \$42,000
The predicted increase in annual salary, in thousands of dollars, for each additional year of experience
The total salary in thousands of dollars after 3.2 years
questions.explanation:
In the equation \(y = 3.2x + 42\), the coefficient \(3.2\) is the slope. In context, the slope represents the rate of change — for each additional year of experience (increase of 1 in \(x\)), the predicted salary increases by 3.2 thousand dollars, or \$3,200.
The constant 42 represents the \(y\)-intercept — the predicted starting salary of \$42,000 with zero years of experience.

questions.stem: Which of the following is equivalent to \(\dfrac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3}\) for \(x \neq 3\)?
questions.explanation:
Factor the numerator as a difference of squares.
$$\frac{x^2 - 9}{x - 3} = \frac{(x+3)(x-3)}{x-3} = x + 3$$
The factor \((x - 3)\) cancels, leaving \(x + 3\). Note that \(x \neq 3\) because the original expression is undefined at \(x = 3\).

questions.stem: The function \(f\) is linear. If \(f(2) = 7\) and \(f(5) = 16\), what is \(f(0)\)?
questions.explanation:
Find the slope using the two given points.
$$m = \frac{16 - 7}{5 - 2} = \frac{9}{3} = 3$$
Use point-slope form to find the \(y\)-intercept: \(f(x) = 3x + b\). Substitute \(f(2) = 7\): \(7 = 6 + b \implies b = 1\). Therefore \(f(0) = 3(0) + 1 = 1\).

questions.stem: A town had a population of \(5{,}000\) at the start of 2010. The population grew at a constant rate of \(4\%\) per year. Which of the following expressions gives the population of the town \(t\) years after the start of 2010?
questions.explanation:
A constant percent growth of \(4\%\) per year means the population is multiplied by \(1.04\) each year. Starting at \(5{,}000\), after \(t\) years the population is \(5{,}000(1.04)^t\).
A) \(0.04^t\) decays to zero. B) \(0.96^t\) models a \(4\%\) decrease. D) Linear, not exponential.

questions.stem: If \(x^2 - 7x + 10 = 0\), what is the positive difference between the two solutions?
questions.explanation:
Factor the quadratic.
$$x^2 - 7x + 10 = (x-2)(x-5) = 0$$
The solutions are \(x = 2\) and \(x = 5\). The positive difference is \(5 - 2 = 3\).

questions.stem: Which of the following is equivalent to \(x^{\frac{2}{3}} \cdot x^{\frac{1}{6}}\) for \(x > 0\)?
questions.explanation:
When multiplying expressions with the same base, add the exponents.
$$x^{\frac{2}{3}} \cdot x^{\frac{1}{6}} = x^{\frac{4}{6} + \frac{1}{6}} = x^{\frac{5}{6}}$$

questions.stem: If \(5(2x-3) = 7(2x-3) - 8\), what is the value of \(2x - 3\)?
questions.explanation:
Let \(u = 2x - 3\). The equation becomes:
$$\begin{aligned}5u &= 7u - 8 \\ -2u &= -8 \\ u &= 4\end{aligned}$$
So \(2x - 3 = 4\).

questions.stem:
$$\frac{5p}{3q} = \frac{2}{r}$$
The given equation relates the positive numbers \(p\), \(q\), and \(r\). Which equation correctly expresses \(p\) in terms of \(q\) and \(r\)?
questions.explanation:
Cross-multiply to eliminate the fractions.
$$5pr = 6q$$
Divide both sides by \(5r\).
$$p = \frac{6q}{5r}$$

questions.stem: The function \(f\) is defined by \(f(x) = x^2 - 8x + 7\). What is the minimum value of \(f(x)\)?
questions.explanation:
Complete the square to write the function in vertex form.
$$\begin{aligned}f(x) &= x^2 - 8x + 7 \\ &= x^2 - 8x + 16 - 16 + 7 \\ &= (x - 4)^2 - 9\end{aligned}$$
The vertex is at \((4, -9)\). Since the parabola opens upward (\(a = 1 > 0\)), the minimum value is \(-9\).

questions.stem: If \((x - k)\) is a factor of \(p(x) = x^3 - 7x + 6\), which of the following could be a value of \(k\)?
questions.explanation:
By the Factor Theorem, \((x - k)\) is a factor of \(p(x)\) if and only if \(p(k) = 0\). Test each choice.
$$ egin{aligned}p(4) &= 64 - 28 + 6 = 42 eq 0 \ p(-1) &= -1 + 7 + 6 = 12 eq 0 \ p(2) &= 8 - 14 + 6 = 0 \checkmark \ p(5) &= 125 - 35 + 6 = 96 eq 0\end{aligned}$$

questions.stem: How many distinct real solutions does the equation \(3x^2 - 6x + 4 = 0\) have?
questions.explanation:
Use the discriminant \(b^2 - 4ac\).
$$(-6)^2 - 4(3)(4) = 36 - 48 = -12$$
Since the discriminant is negative, the equation has no real solutions.

questions.stem: A cylinder has a radius of \(4\) and a height of \(9\). What is the volume of the cylinder?
questions.explanation:
The volume of a cylinder is \(V = \pi r^2 h\).
$$V = \pi (4)^2 (9) = 144\pi$$

questions.stem: In right triangle \(ABC\), angle \(C\) is the right angle and \(\cos(A) = \dfrac{5}{13}\). What is the value of \(\sin(A)\)?
questions.explanation:
\(\cos(A) = \frac{5}{13}\) means adjacent \(= 5\), hypotenuse \(= 13\). Use the Pythagorean theorem.
$$\text{opposite} = \sqrt{13^2 - 5^2} = \sqrt{144} = 12$$
\(\sin(A) = \dfrac{12}{13}\)
